mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.category, cb.id AS child_bom_id FROM mes_bom_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_bom cb ON cb.material_id = i.material_id AND cb.is_default = 1 AND cb.status = 1
mapper.select: WHERE i.bom_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mes_bom_item (bom_id, material_id, qty, loss_rate, ref_des, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.bomId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.lossRate}, #{i.refDes}, #{i.remark}, NOW(), NOW())
